// diagnostic

E0227

A function whose parameter is marked `&` or `&&` is used as a value where the expected function type gives that parameter plain read access.

What

A function whose parameter is marked `&` or `&&` is used as a value where the expected function type gives that parameter plain read access.

Why

A function type gives each parameter plain read access unless it marks a take (`fn(&&T)`), so a value of this function in an unmarked slot would lose the write or take its parameter declares.

Fix

Call the function directly, take the parameter in the function type (`fn(&&T)`) when the function takes it, or pass a lambda that makes that call.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0227: tests/ui/function_type_take_param.stderr.

Error [jet.MoveWithoutMarker]: `f` takes `words`, but `words` is used again later
  --> tests/ui/function_type_take_param.jet:19:14
    |
 19 |     first: f(words)
    |              ^^^^^
  --> tests/ui/function_type_take_param.jet:20:15
    |
 20 |     first + f(words)
    |               ^^^^^ `words` is used again here
 Why: `f` takes ownership of this argument, and a call never copies on its own, so `words` has no value after this call
 Fix: Write `words.copy()` to pass a copy and keep `words`, or reorder so this call is the last use of `words`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0209

Error [jet.MarkedFunctionValue]: `count` can't be used as a function value because its parameter `words` is `&&`
  --> tests/ui/function_type_take_param.jet:24:29
    |
 24 |     slots: Slots{read_only: count, taking: count}
    |                             ^^^^^
 Why: A function type gives each parameter plain read access unless it marks a take (`fn(&&T)`), so a value of `count` would drop the `&&` its parameter declares
 Fix: Call `count` directly, take the parameter in the function type (`fn(&&T)`), or pass a lambda that makes that call
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0227
